column1: # IBC log classification (log contract v1). Tab-separated: event<TAB>extended-regex<TAB>phase<TAB>level
# Lines starting with # are comments. The regex is matched against the whole IBC log line with
# bash's [[ =~ ]] (POSIX ERE). An empty phase means "no phase change".
#   REAL  = seen in this image's IBC output (IBC 3.24.2, IB Gateway 10.50.1g, 2026-11-11;
#   DOCS  = wording from IBC 3.24.x sources, not yet seen in a real log: every other row.
# IBC reports each dialog three times (event=Opened, Activated, Focused); dialog patterns match
# only event=Opened so that one dialog is one event. The login window and the Gateway main
# window share the title "IBKR Gateway", so the login dialog is recognised by IBC's own
# "Login dialog WINDOW_OPENED" line, never by the frame title.

column2: detected (dialog|frame) entitled: Second Factor Authentication; event=(Opened|Activated)
detected dialog entitled: Unrecognized Username or Password; event=Opened
detected dialog entitled: Existing session detected; event=Opened
